reference_exposed_rule: Boolean, initially false; monotonic false to true. Opening the official audit after core completion records true; subsequent core edits retain it. This logs interface exposure, not actual reading or external access.
completion_rule: Five non-null core ratings (1–5 or uncertain) and reviewed_full_scope=true, where full_scope means the assigned physical-page window, not the complete article/appendix. Auxiliary checks do not gate completion.

scope_policy.primary: Main-paper writing visible within physical PDF pages 1 through min(9, total_pages), including title, abstract, prose, in-scope technical material and captions.
scope_policy.supporting: The full target PDF and appendix remain available as auxiliary reference. References and appendices, even within the first nine pages, are not core-scored. Later main-paper pages are also outside core scoring.
scope_policy.boundary_rule: The planned page-window cutoff is not a manuscript defect or a failed transport. Do not penalize continuation beyond page nine, a missing out-of-window conclusion, or reasonable appendix deferral.
scope_policy.completion: Review the assigned page window, not the full appendix. Unplanned missing pages, unreadable evidence or request truncation remain input failures.
